domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 隧道内用于支护、承载和防护的衬砌结构。
usage_overview: 在列车—轨道—隧道相互作用分析中，隧道衬砌作为围岩与轨道之间传递作用的结构纳入动力模型，用于分析隧道错动条件下的系统响应。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P089.title: Dynamic analysis of water-rich heavy haul railway tunnels considering basement defects evolution and train effects
P089.authors: Z Peng, C Shi, Z Zhu, L Xu, C Liu, M Lei
P089.label: Peng等（2025）

complete_examples.text: Niu [3] pointed out that the early construction quality, design, and acceptance standards of tunnels were relatively low, resulting in initial defects in the tunnel lining structure.

It finds that foundation defects have a significant impact on the train’s operational state, track vibration displacement, and vibration stress of the tunnel lining structure, especially under the coupling effect of basement voids and the water-rich environment, which has the greatest impact.
